scope: WorkSwarm dependency context CAS preview fan-out
source_changes: ArtifactPreviewCache::read_many loads independent verified previews through a bounded Tokio JoinSet with default caller limit 4.
Results are reassembled in original direct-dependency order; duplicate (hash, byte-limit) reads share one Arc page within the batch and operation-local cache.
CAS length, artifact-declared size, UTF-8 truncation and the retained-cache ceiling continue to be checked.
assemble_context_slice reserves each read from the existing 8 KiB aggregate / 2.4 KiB per-artifact prompt budget before fan-out; it reads only artifacts that are direct dependencies.
regression_test_source: bounded_batch_preview_reads_keep_order_and_deduplicate_verified_pages covers order, duplicate identity, UTF-8 preview truncation and declared-size drift.

validation.git_diff_check: passed for touched tracked source; new module files are checked for UTF-8 and trailing whitespace separately

cargo_test.required: at least 6 GB free and under 80% used

performance_evidence: No elapsed-time benchmark was run. The code removes serial awaits among independent artifact reads and bounds fan-out at 4; measured Team latency improvement is not yet established.
remaining_risks: The new Rust code and unit test have not been type-checked or executed because the repository resource gate rejected Cargo.
No live ProductEval Single-vs-Team paired comparison was run.
The cloud task queue still holds a global lock across remote transport awaits; that independent bottleneck remains open.
